postNotes: Login logs stay empty until the project adds the observer with authn.AddLoginObserver(servicelogmgmt.RecordLoginEvent) from project-owned assembly code, for example module/module.go. Add it exactly once: observers multicast, so a second call records every login twice.
Operation logs come from the audit pipeline: set AUDIT_ENABLED=true (or the audit.enabled config key), otherwise the operation log stays empty.
Register the retention job in project-owned cronjob setup: cronjob.Register(servicelogmgmt.Cleanup, "0 0 * * * *", "cleanup logs").
